summary: Studio City International Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K attaching an announcement from its subsidiary Studio City Finance Limited regarding the completion of a partial redemption of US$165 million of its 6.500% Senior Notes due 2028, representing 33% of the initial aggregate principal amount, redeemed on July 18, 2026 at par. The notes were cancelled; US$335 million remain outstanding. This is a routine debt management action by the issuer, not a special-situations event. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is involved. What to watch: further redemptions or refinancing of the remaining notes.
